data_table_surface_label: Example data-table posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: Bounded data-table surface for official voter-information routes that require voters to find controlling facts inside row/column structures such as office directories, schedules, or deadline matrices.

tables.table_role_note: Answer-bearing directory table for current site hours, address, accessibility notes, and official contact fallback.
tables.header_context_note: Visible and stacked/mobile variants preserve the relationship among site name, address, hours, and current status fields.
tables.responsive_mode_note: Desktop shows a multi-column table; narrow widths switch to a reviewed stacked-row presentation that preserves the header labels next to each value.
tables.sort_filter_note: The default grouping is by municipality and active sort state is visibly labeled when users change the ordering.
tables.row_findability_note: Users can re-find a named site through ordinary search/filter controls without losing the current municipality/status context that explains why the row appears.

header_association_note: Row and column headers remain meaningful in desktop and narrow-screen variants so the visible values keep the same official meaning.
responsive_overflow_note: If any columns require overflow on narrow screens, the route preserves an obvious cue that additional answer-bearing columns remain off-screen and reviews whether a stacked presentation is clearer.
stacked_mobile_note: Reviewed mobile/stacked variants preserve the controlling labels and do not reduce the table to unlabeled values or ambiguous cards.
default_sort_or_grouping_note: The route records the default grouping or sort order and treats that default as part of the public answer surface when it affects which rows are seen first.
filter_state_visibility_note: Search/filter state remains visible so hidden rows are not mistaken for absent official options.
row_findability_note: Answer-bearing rows can be re-found after routine reopen, revisit, or share flows without trial-and-error scanning of a large table.
print_or_save_row_context_note: If the route expects users to keep a record, print/save output preserves enough row and header context that the retained record still shows what controlled.
help_or_overview_escape_note: Each table-bearing route preserves a visible path back to broader official help or overview content when the table alone does not resolve the voter's case.
